caseName: Northwest Savings Bank, PaSA v. Welch
caseNameFull: Northwest Savings Bank, PaSA v. Welch

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of James B. Beam Distilling Co. v. Georgia, ante, p. 529, and Lampf, Pleva, Lipkind, Prupis & Petigrow v. Gilbertson, ante, p. 350.
